messages.author: e2ae0e03fdfb0c6a
messages.subject: install problem on Ubuntu
parts:
I'm attempting to install Rhipe 0.64 on a 64 bit Ubuntu system and it
all seems to go well until the very last step. From within R it just
hangs at the end with an error message ...

*** installing help indices
** building package indices ...
** testing if installed package can be loaded

I've been using Tommy Hall's install instructions at
http://www.thattommyhall.com/

I've used R for sometime and think that I've installed hadoop
correctly ... but

Any suggestions where to start?

Thanks

Jim

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: install problem on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi Jim,

This looks similar to Tom's problem - it could be a permissions issue.
R does not appear to have a mechanism to provide parameters to the
library() command.
So, the link (see [1]) is a Rhipe 0.65 (still rough and not on the
website).

Download, install and type the following commands

R CMD INSTALL Rhipe_0.65.tar.gz
R
(Inside R)

> library(Rhipe)
> Rhipe:::first.run(buglevel=2000)

and describe the output

Cheers
Saptarshi


[1] http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/tmp/Rhipe_0.65.tar.gz
[2] A few things coming in the final version of 0.65 is
[a] rhex will be async=TRUE by default, monitor it using rhstatus
or wait for it using rhjoin
[b] retrieve errors in a more R like fashion (e.g. rherror) rather
than seeing them spew all over the environment.

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: install problem on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi Jim

If you notice the last line of your output,

>sh: /usr/local/bin/hadoop: not found

Which is kind of a fault of mine. I run hadoop from $HADOOP/bin/hadoop
which is clearly asking for trouble.

Download a new version [1], and specify the environment variable HADOOP_BIN

If you specify HADOOP, i will set HADOOP_BIN=$HADOOP/bin/
If you specify $HADOOP_BIN, i will use that.
Ultimately, i will call $HADOOP_BIN/hadoop.

Repeat as before

R
library(Rhipe)
Rhipe:::first.run(buglevel=3000)


[1] http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/tmp/Rhipe_0.65.1.tar.gz

Saptarshi Guha

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: install problem on Ubuntu
parts:
Hi Jim,

This is as expected. Notice


- bin is in /usr/local/hadoop/bin
- lib is in /usr/local/hadoop/lib       
- conf is in usr/local/hadoop/conf
- HADOOP=/usr/local
- HADOOP_LIB=/usr/local/hadoop/lib
- HADOOP_CONF_DIR=/usr/local/hadoop/conf

Notice, RHIPE says

Warning in onload.2(libname, pkgname) :
  HADOOP_BIN is missing, using $HADOOP/bin

but HADOOP is /usr/local, so $HADOOP/bin is /usr/local/bin and *not* /usr/local/hadoop/bin
you could try setting another variable like this

in R, for your particular setup
> Sys.setenv(HADOOP_BIN="/usr/local/hadoop/bin")
# and then
> library(Rhipe)
> Rhipe:::first.run(buglevel=3000)
and press enter a few times (sometimes i see a message from PersonalServer but no R > prompt which is odd, an enter fixes this)

Cheers
Joy
